name: university-bus-management
description: Production-oriented university bus operations, booking, tracking, and administration platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @bus/api" "npm run dev -w @bus/web"
scripts.db:validate: npm exec --prefix apps/api -- prisma validate --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec --prefix apps/api -- prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run db:validate && npm audit --audit-level=high
